hero.title: Graph-Powered Conversational AI
hero.subtitle: Design, visualize, and run complex AI workflows on an interactive canvas. Build branching conversations, orchestrate multi-step reasoning, and interact through a polished chat experience.

header.title: Why Linear Chat Falls Short
header.subtitle: Your thinking isn't a straight line—it branches, explores, and iterates. Traditional AI chat forces you into a single thread, losing context and clarity.

messages.user1: My API endpoint is too slow. How can I optimize it?
messages.ai1: You could optimize the database query by adding an index...
messages.frustration1: Wait, what if caching is better? You scroll up to reconsider...
messages.user2: Actually, could we try a caching strategy instead?
messages.ai2: Sure, here's how to implement Redis caching...
messages.frustration2: Now you have two competing solutions in one messy thread.
messages.user3: What about async processing? And can you show me the database query again?
messages.frustration3: Context lost. You're copy-pasting and starting over.

header.subtitle: Meridian transforms AI interaction into a visual graph. Connect nodes to build powerful workflows that preserve the rich context and relationships between ideas, unlocking capabilities linear chats can't match.

visual.title: Visual-First Design
visual.text: See your entire AI workflow at a glance. No more hidden context or mysterious jumps between topics.

context.title: True Context Management
context.text: Branch conversations naturally, merge insights from multiple sources, and maintain precise control over what information flows where.

orchestration.title: Model Orchestration
orchestration.text: Route queries to specialized models, run parallel comparisons, and synthesize results automatically.

developer.title: Developer-Native
developer.text: Deep GitHub integration, syntax highlighting for 220+ languages, and LaTeX support built-in.

header.title: Built for Complex Workflows
header.subtitle: Meridian provides a powerful, developer-centric toolset to move beyond the limitations of linear chat.

visualCanvas.title: Visual Graph Canvas
visualCanvas.description: The heart of Meridian is an infinite, interactive canvas where you architect AI workflows by connecting nodes. Drag, drop, and arrange components to visualize complex logic that would be impossible to follow in a linear chat. Watch execution flow in real-time with animated connections and live status indicators.

executionControl.title: Execution Control
executionControl.description: Select any node to execute precisely what you need:

runUpstream.title: Run Upstream
runUpstream.description: Execute all parent nodes feeding into your selection.

runDownstream.title: Run Downstream
runDownstream.description: Execute selected nodes and all their children.

runAll.title: Run All
runAll.description: Process the entire graph from start to finish.

nodeSystem.title: Modular Node System
nodeSystem.description: Combine a wide array of specialized nodes to feed your AI rich context, perform complex processing, and build adaptive logic.

inputNodes.title: Input Nodes: Feed Your AI Rich Context

prompt.title: Prompt Node
prompt.description: Structured text input with templating support.

attachment.title: Attachment Node
attachment.description: Upload PDFs, images, CSVs, and documents that become part of your workflow context.

github.title: GitHub Node
github.description: Connect your GitHub account to browse repositories and inject entire codebases, specific files, or directories as context. Perfect for code review, documentation generation, and architecture analysis.

textToText.title: Text-to-Text
textToText.description: Standard LLM calls with full parameter control. Connect multiple models in sequence for specialized processing.

parallelization.title: Parallelization
parallelization.description: Execute one prompt against multiple AI models simultaneously (e.g., GPT-5, Claude, and Gemini at once), then use an aggregator model to synthesize a single, superior answer. Ideal for fact-checking, diverse perspective synthesis, and robust analysis.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Create conditional logic that dynamically selects the next node or model based on input content. Build stateful agents that adapt their strategy, route to specialized models, or escalate complex queries automatically.

integratedExperience.title: Integrated Chat & Graph Experience
integratedExperience.description: Seamlessly switch between visual graph and clean chat interface. The chat view presents a user-friendly conversation while the graph captures the underlying complexity. Start a conversation in chat, then hop into the graph to branch, merge, or modify the workflow mid-stream. Every message in chat corresponds to a node in your graph—full transparency, zero abstraction loss.

modelManagement.title: Advanced Model Management via OpenRouter
modelManagement.description: Access 300+ AI models through a single API key. Meridian's deep OpenRouter integration provides:

pinning.title: Model Pinning
pinning.description: Keep frequently-used models at your fingertips.

filtering.title: Intelligent Filtering
filtering.description: Hide free or paid models based on your needs.

transparency.title: Cost Transparency
transparency.description: See price per token and context window size before you execute.

control.title: Parameter Control
control.description: Set global defaults and override per-canvas or per-node.

modelManagement.supported: Supported Providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Meta, and dozens of open-source models.

technicalTooling.title: Rich Content & Technical Tooling
technicalTooling.description: Meridian is built for technical workflows with first-class support for developer-centric content.

markdown.title: Full Markdown Support
markdown.description: Headers, tables, lists, and formatting rendered beautifully.

latex.title: LaTeX Rendering
latex.description: Complex mathematical notation with KaTeX integration.

syntax.title: Syntax Highlighting
syntax.description: 220+ programming languages with dynamic grammar loading for minimal footprint.

diagrams.title: AI-Powered Diagrams
diagrams.description: Generate Mermaid.js flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, and entity diagrams directly in chat. Export as PNG or edit the source code.

enterpriseFoundation.title: Enterprise-Grade Foundation
enterpriseFoundation.description: Built from the ground up with security, scalability, and observability in mind.

auth.title: Secure Authentication
auth.description: OAuth 2.0 (GitHub, Google) + username/password with JWT and rotating refresh tokens.

storage.title: Hybrid Data Storage
storage.description: PostgreSQL for structured data, Neo4j for graph relationships—optimal performance for both queries and traversals.

cost.title: Cost Tracking
cost.description: Every API call shows exact cost and token usage in the chat footer. Monitor spending at glance.

sentry.title: Sentry Integration
sentry.description: Optional real-time error tracking and performance monitoring for both frontend and backend.

docker.title: Docker Deployment
docker.description: Production-ready setup with pre-built images or source builds. One-command deployment with persistent data volumes.
